title: MOTION (MCOSKER - HUTT) relative to funding for repair services at the Warner Grand Theatre within Council District Fifteen (CD 15).
text:
[Council File 26-0011-S26; CD 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (MCOSKER - HUTT) relative to funding for repair services at the Warner Grand Theatre within Council District Fifteen (CD 15).
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER $62,655.88 from Various Recreation Parks Facilities Fund No. 209/88, Account No. 88C810 to the following GSD accounts for repair services at the Warner Grand Theatre within Council District 15 as noted in the Motion, attached to the Council file.
2. AUTHORIZE the GSD to prepare the Controller's Instructions and to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion.
